title: Discovering the Gene(s) Causing Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH)
brief_summary: The primary objective of the study is to find the gene(s) responsible for causing DDH. The secondary objective of the study is to determine the mode of genetic transmission of DDH.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with radiographic and clinical diagnosis of DDH will be included.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other forms of arthritis:
* osteoarthritis
* inflammatory arthropathies
* vascular necrosis
study_population: Patients who have been diagnosed with hip dysplasia and their family members.
